name: Football Scouter Engine

workflow.description: Calculate exact 24h temporal window and initialize session logs.
Identify all football matches within the temporal window using authorized sources.
Apply the scoring matrix to each discovered match. Filter those with score >= 8.
Cross-reference data between sources and verify evidence for each score.
Generate the final technical report and execution logs.

constraints: No halluciations: every data point must have a source.
Autonomous: no user intervention after launch.
Determinism: same input data must yield same evaluation scores.
